chunks: And by his chain, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The best of you are the possessors of Nuha (intellect/reason).' It was said, 'O Messenger of Allah! Who are the possessors of Nuha?' He (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'They are the possessors of excellent morals, and strong reason, and those who maintain kinship ties, and those who are righteous to their mothers and fathers, and those who attend to the poor, the neighbors, and the orphans, and who feed people with food, and spread greetings throughout the world, and they pray while people are sleeping and heedless.'
ai.seo_question: Who are the possessors of Nuha according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: In Shia scholarship, 'Nuha' is distinguished from mere intelligence by its integration with ethical conduct (akhlaq) and practical piety, marking the ideal Momin as one who balances spiritual vigilance with social responsibility. This hadith from Al-Kafi underscores that true excellence is demonstrated through specific acts of kindness—such as feeding the poor and maintaining family ties—while engaging in night prayers (Qiyam) amidst the heedlessness of the masses, reflecting the concept of 'Ibada al-Ghafilin'.

en.hubeali:
And by his chain, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>

having said: ‘The Prophetsaww said: ‘The best of you are the possessors of the ‘Nuha’. It was said, ‘O Rasool-Allahsaww! Who are the possessors of the ‘Nuha’?’ Hesaww said: ‘The possessors of the excellent morals, and having strong power of reason, and the helpers of the relatives, and the righteous with the mothers and the fathers, and the ones who are committed to (help) the poor, and the neighbours, and the orphans, and are feeding the food, and they are disclosing the greetings (first) in the world, and they are praying Salāt while the people are sleeping being oblivious’.
en.sarwar: 32. Through the same chain of narrators it is narrated from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following:

“The Holy Prophet has said, ‘The best among you are those who possess al-Nuha’.’ He was asked, ‘O Messenger of Allah, who are possessors of al-Nuha’?’ He then said, ‘They are those who possess excellent moral discipline and a heavy power of reason, maintain good relations with relatives, who are kind to mothers and fathers, committed to help the poor, neighbors, orphans, who serve food (to the needy), who spread peace in the world and who pray when people sleep negligently.’”
